scripts.build: tsc -p visitor-core && cp visitor-core/src/schema.d.ts visitor-core/dist/schema.d.ts && tsc -p node && cp node/src/schema.d.ts node/dist/schema.d.ts && tsc -p react-widget && cp react-widget/src/clickfix.d.ts react-widget/dist/clickfix.d.ts && tsc -p react-native && tsc -p expo
scripts.test: pnpm build && tsc -p type-tests && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm test:native
scripts.publish:check: pnpm build && for p in node visitor-core react-widget react-native expo; do (cd $p && pnpm publish --dry-run --no-git-checks --access public); done
